result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate on 30 days’ written notice without an early-termination charge, receives a refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period, and Vendor has no convenience right during a term. The amendment otherwise preserves the existing cause-based and Order Form provisions. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” adds a partial-service termination right not expressly required by the playbook and may exceed the minimum necessary change. Drafting is professional, but Section 9.4 should appear before Section 9.5, and “during a term” could be clarified as “during any committed term.”
